# Requirements-Quality Checklist: Smart Todo & Task REST API

**Purpose**: reviewer-owned check that the requirements are specific, testable,
and complete before `/speckit.implement`.
**Created**: 2026-11-14
**Feature**: `spec.md` (same dir)
**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. `[x]` = criterion reviewed &
satisfied for requirements quality (not implementation completion).

## Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Every user story has at least one binary-testable acceptance
      criterion (US1–US4 all have Given/When/Then ACs).
- [x] CHK002 Every FR (FR-1..FR-8) maps to at least one AC and one test
      (see plan.md §Spec-to-Test Traceability, 100% coverage).
- [x] CHK003 All status codes (201/200/204/400/404/409) are declared in
      `openapi.yaml` and exercised by tests.

## Clarity & Testability

- [x] CHK004 Each AC is specific enough to derive a single exact assertion
      (`assert.strictEqual(response.status, N)`); no "reasonable"/"should"
      vagueness.
- [x] CHK005 Edge cases (empty store, bad priority, malformed JSON, unknown
      id) are enumerated in spec §Edge Cases and have tests.
- [x] CHK006 Determinism is explicit: overdue is a pure function of `?now=`
      (C-6), so a test can pin the reference time.

## Security / No-weakening

- [x] CHK007 No secret/credential placeholders in any requirement; validation
      responses are fixed-shape `{ error }`.
- [x] CHK008 Repairs are scoped to `src/app.js`/`tests/app.test.js` only —
      the contract and assertions are immutable (Constitution III).

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads these markers as a gate; none are blocking.
- A checklist item may only be un-checked if a requirement-quality gap is
  found; none were found in this pass.
